In the tenth month, on the first day guimwei, Prince of Xianyang Yuan Tan was made Grand Tutor and Pan Xiangle was made Minister of Works.
咸陽王坦 is Yuan Tan, a Northern Wei imperial prince, not a Gao.
The Eastern Wei emperor sent Acting Grand Commandant Prince of Pengcheng Gao Shao and Minister of Works Pan Xiangle to invest him with the edict, saying:
The Eastern Wei emperor sent Acting Grand Commandant Prince of Pengcheng Yuan Shao and Minister of Works Pan Xiangle to invest him with the edict, saying:
彭城王韶 is Yuan Shao, a Northern Wei imperial prince, not a Gao.

Gao Cheng and the others were frightened and broke; Gao Yang mustered his forces and fought Peng Yue as an enemy, and though Peng removed his helmet and spoke from the heart, Gao Yang still captured him and presented him as captive.

Gao Cheng and the others were frightened and broke; Gao Yang mustered his forces and fought Peng Le as an enemy, and though Peng removed his helmet and spoke from the heart, Gao Yang still captured him and presented him as captive.
彭樂 is read Peng Le.
In the twelfth month, on jiyou day, Bing Inspector Peng Yue was made Minister of Education and Grand Tutor Helou Ren was made Bing Inspector.
In the twelfth month, on jiyou day, Bing Inspector Peng Le was made Minister of Education and Grand Tutor Heba Ren was made Bing Inspector.
彭樂 is Peng Le; 賀拔仁 is Heba Ren.
In former times the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao were divided without, Mao and Bi entered to assist — the charge within and without the Prince ought to sum them.
In former times the Duke of Zhou and Duke of Shao were divided without, the Dukes of Mao and Bi entered to assist — the charge within and without the Prince ought to sum them.
毛、畢 are the Dukes of Mao and Bi.
Again he sent Acting Grand Commandant Prince of Pengcheng Gao Shao and Acting Minister of Works Jing Xianjun to present the register, saying:
Again he sent Acting Grand Commandant Prince of Pengcheng Yuan Shao and Acting Minister of Works Jing Xianjun to present the register, saying:
彭城王韶 is Yuan Shao, a Northern Wei imperial prince, not a Gao.

He also sent a sealed letter to the emperor, dispatching Acting Grand Mentor Prince Pengcheng Gao Shao and Acting Minister of Works Jing Xianjun to present the imperial seal and cord; the abdication followed the ancient precedents of Yao, of Han, and of Wei.

He also sent a sealed letter to the emperor, dispatching Acting Grand Guardian Prince Pengcheng Yuan Shao and Acting Minister of Works Jing Xianjun to present the imperial seal and cord; the abdication followed the ancient precedents of Yao, of Han, and of Wei.
彭城王韶 is Yuan Shao; 太保 is Grand Guardian.
Minister of Works Chief Gao Longzhi also led the hundred officials in urging Gao Yang to accept the throne.
Director of the Masters of Writing Gao Longzhi also led the hundred officials in urging Gao Yang to accept the throne.
尚書令 is Director of the Masters of Writing.

When the time comes, fate moves on—Emperors Gui and Shun could not linger on the throne; when the world changed, Yu could not remain in the north facing south. How much less can one as unworthy as I hesitate and delay!

When the time comes, fate moves on—Shun of the Gui clan could not linger on the throne; when the world changed, Yu could not remain in the north facing south. How much less can one as unworthy as I hesitate and delay!
媯舜 is one person, Shun of the Gui clan.
The Wei emperor therefore bowed to heaven's decree, thinking to lift his robe and go—as Yao and Yu did before him—casting off the throne like an old shoe.
The Wei emperor therefore bowed to heaven's decree, thinking to lift his robe and go—as Yao and Shun did before him—casting off the throne like an old shoe.
唐、虞 here denote Yao and Shun (Tang and Yu), not Yu the Great.

Meritorious ministers were enfeoffed: Kudi Gan as Prince of Zhangwu, Helü Jin as Prince of Xianyang, Heba Ren as Prince of Anding, Han Gui as Prince of Ande, Kezhuhun Daoyuan as Prince of Fufeng, Peng Yue as Prince of Chenliu, and Pan Xiangle as Prince of Hedong.

Meritorious ministers were enfeoffed: Kudi Gan as Prince of Zhangwu, Hulü Jin as Prince of Xianyang, Heba Ren as Prince of Anding, Han Gui as Prince of Ande, Kezhuhun Daoyuan as Prince of Fufeng, Peng Le as Prince of Chenliu, and Pan Xiangle as Prince of Hedong.
彭樂 is Peng Le; 斛律金 is Hulü Jin.

On gengyin an edict appointed Grand Preceptor Kudi Gan as Grand Mentor, Minister of Works Peng Yue as Grand Marshal, Minister of Education Pan Xiangle as Minister of Works, and Opening-Fu Third Rank Sima Ziru as Minister of Education.

On gengyin an edict appointed Grand Preceptor Kudi Gan as Grand Steward, Minister over the Masses Peng Le as Grand Marshal, Minister of Works Pan Xiangle as Minister over the Masses, and Opening-Fu Third Rank Sima Ziru as Minister of Works.
太宰 is Grand Steward; the source has 司徒彭樂, 司空潘相樂為司徒 and 司馬子如為司空, which the translation swapped.
On yimao Minister of Works Chief Prince of Pingyuan Gao Longzhi was ordered to record Masters of Writing affairs, and Left Vice Minister Prince of Pingyang Gao Yan became Minister of Works Chief.

On yimao Director of the Masters of Writing Prince of Pingyuan Gao Longzhi was ordered to record Masters of Writing affairs, and Left Vice Minister Prince of Pingyang Gao Yan became Director of the Masters of Writing.
尚書令 is Director of the Masters of Writing, not a works office.
In the third month, on bingwu day, Prince of Xiangcheng Gao You died.
In the third month, on bingwu day, Prince of Xiangcheng Gao Yu died.
襄城王淯 is Gao Yu (淯), not Gao You (浟).
On gengshen day Grand Minister of Works Sima Ziru was dismissed for an offense.
On gengshen day Minister of Works Sima Ziru was dismissed for an offense.
司空 is Minister of Works.
In the sixth month, on gengwu day, former Grand Minister of Works Sima Ziru was made Grand Commandant.
In the sixth month, on gengwu day, former Minister of Works Sima Ziru was made Grand Commandant.
司空 is Minister of Works.

In the third month, on wuzi day, Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, inspector of Sizhou, was made commissioner with full powers and grand commander of the southern route; Grand Minister of Works Pan Xiang was made commissioner with full powers and grand commander of the southeastern route; and with Xingtai Xin Shu they led armies south to attack.

In the third month, on wuzi day, Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, inspector of Sizhou, was made commissioner with full powers and grand commander of the southern route; Minister over the Masses Pan Xiangle was made commissioner with full powers and grand commander of the southeastern route; and with Xingtai Xin Shu they led armies south to attack.
司徒潘相樂 is Minister over the Masses Pan Xiangle.
An edict ordered Grand Minister of Works Pan Xiang to lead five thousand picked cavalry by the eastern route toward Qingshan.
An edict ordered Minister over the Masses Pan Xiangle to lead five thousand picked cavalry by the eastern route toward Qingshan.
司徒潘相樂 is Minister over the Masses Pan Xiangle.
Pan Xiang also routed a separate Khitan division at Qingshan.
Pan Xiangle also routed a separate Khitan division at Qingshan.
On guisi day an edict advanced King Xiao Yi of Liang to Emperor of Liang.
On guisi day an edict advanced King Xiao Yi of Liang to Ruler of Liang.
梁主 is ruler of Liang, not yet emperor.
That month Emperor Wen of Zhou deposed the Western Wei ruler and set up Yuwen Kuo as Emperor Gong.
That month Emperor Wen of Zhou deposed the Western Wei ruler and set up Yuan Kuo, Prince of Qi, as Emperor Gong.
齊王廓 is the Western Wei imperial prince Yuan Kuo, not a Yuwen.

On gengzi day Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, Inspector of Sizhou, was made Grand Tutor; Wei Can, Minister of Works, became Minister over the Masses; Houmochen Xiang, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, became Minister of Works; Prince of Pingyang Gao Yan, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Changshan Gao Yan became Director of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan, Director of the Secretariat, became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

On gengzi day Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, Inspector of Sizhou, was made Grand Guardian; Wei Can, Minister of Works, became Minister over the Masses; Houmochen Xiang, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, became Minister of Works; Prince of Pingyang Gao Yan, Director of the Masters of Writing, was made Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Changshan Gao Yan became Director of the Masters of Writing; Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan, Director of the Secretariat, became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

The emperor ordered Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, Prince of Hedong Pan Xiangyue, Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao, and others to march to his relief; before they arrived Jiangling fell, and Emperor Yuan of Liang was killed by the Western Wei general Yu Jin.

The emperor ordered Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, Prince of Hedong Pan Xiangle, Prince of Pingyuan Duan Shao, and others to march to his relief; before they arrived Jiangling fell, and Emperor Yuan of Liang was killed by the Western Wei general Yu Jin.

At Jiankang the Liang general Wang Sengbian and his allies raised Prince Jin'an Xiao Fangzhi as Grand Preceptor and Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad, provisionally appointing the full roster of officials.

At Jiankang the Liang general Wang Sengbian and his allies raised Prince Jin'an Xiao Fangzhi as Grand Steward and Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad, provisionally appointing the full roster of officials.
They sent back Lu Fahuo, Liang Inspector of Ying Province.
They sent back Lu Fahe, Liang Inspector of Ying Province.

In the second month, on jiazi day, Lu Fahuo was made Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Commander of Military Affairs for ten provinces, Grand Commandant, Grand Commander, and Grand Mobile Headquarters of the Southwestern Circuit; Song Chi of Liang, General Who Pacifies the North, Palace Attendant, and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Bearer of the Staff of Authority, General of Agile Cavalry, and Inspector of Ying Province.

In the second month, on jiazi day, Lu Fahe was made Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Commander of Military Affairs for ten provinces, Grand Commandant, Grand Commander, and Grand Mobile Headquarters of the Southwestern Circuit; Song Chi of Liang, General Who Pacifies the North, Palace Attendant, and Inspector of Jing Province, was made Bearer of the Staff of Authority, General of Agile Cavalry, and Inspector of Ying Province.

On renchen day Grand Commander Xiao Gui led troops to the Yangzi and sent Commander Liu Damo and others across the river to hold Shitou.

That month Liu Damo, hard pressed by Chen Baxian's attack, surrendered Shitou.

On jihai day Grand Guardian and Sizhou Inspector Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue died.
The late Shizong's two sons Gao Xiaohang and Gao Yanzong were enfeoffed as Prince of Guangning and Prince of Ande.
The late Shizong's two sons Gao Xiaoheng and Gao Yanzong were enfeoffed as Prince of Guangning and Prince of Ande.

That month the emperor, holding that eating meat severed compassion, thereafter ate no meat at all.

On yisi day Prince You of Pengcheng, minister of works, was additionally made grand commandant, and the emperor's son Shaolian was enfeoffed as Prince of Changle Commandery.

That month Li Huaize and Lu Renhui were dispatched as envoys to Xiao Zhuang.
